text:
ashley: Quick follow-up from BlueHarbor postmortem — TL;DR: VPC peering flap during maintenance + on-prem NAT failover revealed isolation bug when return path was asymmetric. Need owners, dates, and a short validation drill. Prefer owners confirmed by EOD.

rahul: I'll take peering healthcheck + CI integration. Will reuse existing infra libs. Target 2024-07-01.

ben: I'll own the escalation/runbook edits and the customer-facing remediation notes. Will add the asymmetric-routing checklist. ETA 2024-06-28.

kai: I'll build a lightweight churn simulator in staging to reproduce BGP flap + NAT failover and capture pcaps. Need a staging host from infra. Proposed test window 2024-06-30 10:00 PT.

ashley: Staging endpoint: blueharbor-stg.peer.redwood.internal:11777. Capture pcap + tcpdump; tag captures with customer id.

rahul: Suggest alert: "peer_flap_rate > 3/min" + auto-annotate recent peering config pushes and notify oncall. I'll open alert PR.

infra-bot: Created alert /alerts/peer-flap-rate (threshold=3/min). Linked runbook: /runbooks/peering-isolation-playbook.

ben: Action items consolidated:
- rahul: peering healthcheck + CI gate (owner:rahul) / due: 2024-07-01
- kai: churn simulator + capture hooks (owner:kai) / due: 2024-06-30
- ben: runbook + customer remediation note (owner:ben) / due: 2024-06-28
- infra-bot: create alert + annotate runbook (owner:infra-bot) / due: 2024-06-25

ashley: We'll label this pattern "dedicated-isolation-asym-routing" in the recurring incidents tracker. I'll add rows to the remediation spreadsheet and follow up in Tuesday's remediation sync.

kai: Quick note — can we add a synthetic symmetric-path check in nightly health tests? That would have caught this earlier.

rahul: Good idea. Adding to healthcheck scope.

ashley: If anyone reassigns ownership, post here so I can keep the tracker accurate. Closing for new owners unless there are changes.
